text:
See ground rise and day shorten with dust from bloody combat, in bulls' jealous courage driven by love?


See blood, smoke from black brow, and stubborn struggle the loving heart displays?


Then why, Lisi, marvel that when love dries my veins a volcano bursts in rage?


Can bulls feel fury, while you forbid me to deafen mountains with weeping?

translation.title: Comparing Two Jealous Bulls, He Asks Lisi Not to Wonder at His Jealousy
